args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy; v2.3.1 was unhealthy).
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback (on-call paged).
3. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — The `rollback` tool was persistently unavailable (503 after retries), so I used `deploy` of v2.3.0 as the alternative to restore the healthy version in all production regions. This succeeded and was verified.

**Result:** checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, with error rate back down to 0.002.

**Note:** The incident INC-0001 remains open — you may want to close it after confirming no further issues.
